name: aoe2-lsp
description: Language server support for Age of Empires II random map scripts (.rms) and XS (.xs), powered by the aoe2-lsp binary.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The language server only parses workspace files and never executes them; extension settings stay honored in untrusted workspaces.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with AoE2 RMS/XS Language Server
walkthroughs.description: From the self-installing server to a map running in the game.

steps.title: The server installs itself
steps.description: Activation resolves the binary automatically — an explicit aoe2lsp.serverPath wins. Click the status-bar item to watch the resolution.

steps.title: Open a map script
steps.description: Include paths resolve out of the box — the Steam install is detected and the game's resource folders are added automatically.

steps.title: Read the diagnostics
steps.description: Unknown names with did-you-mean, argument checks, XS types and in-game verified nuances — each with a suppressible code.

steps.title: Use completion, hover and signature help
steps.description: The game's vocabulary, snippets, cross-file rename — and willRenameFiles updating includes when a file moves.

steps.title: Deploy the map to the game
steps.description: Copy the map and its include dependencies into a local mod's random-map-scripts folder with one command.

aoe2lsp.serverPath.markdownDescription: Optional override: explicit path to an `aoe2-lsp` binary. An explicitly set value wins over auto-resolution and disables network downloads. The default (`aoe2-lsp`) is not an override — it falls through to the version cache, then PATH, then (with `#aoe2lsp.download.mode#` `auto`) a GitHub Releases download. Build it from the aoe-rms-lsp repository (`go build ./cmd/aoe2-lsp`) or install a release binary.

aoe2lsp.download.mode.markdownDescription: `auto`: resolve the server as explicit `#aoe2lsp.serverPath#` → cached version in the extension's global storage → PATH → download from GitHub Releases (latest release, SHA256-verified against `SHA256SUMS`, extracted with the system `tar`). `off`: no network access at all — cache → PATH only.

aoe2lsp.diagnostics.severityOverrides.markdownDescription: Maps a diagnostic code (`unknown-command`, `undefined-symbol`, `deprecated-effect-percent`, ...) to a severity: `error`, `warning`, `info`, `hint` or `none` (suppresses the diagnostic).

aoe2lsp.deploy.targetDir.markdownDescription: Absolute path of the destination folder for the **Deploy map to game** command — a mod's `resources/_common/random-map-scripts` folder (e.g. `%USERPROFILE%\Games\Age of Empires 2 DE\<account>\mods\local\<mod>\resources\_common\random-map-scripts`). Left empty, a single local mod under `%USERPROFILE%\Games\Age of Empires 2 DE` is detected automatically; zero or several candidates require this setting.

aoe2lsp.includeRoots.markdownDescription: Extra absolute directories searched (in order, after the including file's directory) when resolving `#include` / `#includeXS`. Useful game folders under the AoE2 DE install: `resources/_common/random-map-scripts` (stock maps shipped as loose files) and `resources/_common/xs` (`Constants.xs`, `Effects.xs`, `x256tech.xs`, `ailib/Geometry.xs` for `#includeXS`). Left unset, a Steam install of the game is detected automatically (an explicit setting always wins).
